subject.title: fix(security): narrow sandbox parent to exact active session workspace to prevent cross-agent media read (#107972)

question: Should all agent-scoped media callers without an explicit active sandbox workspace lose sandbox-directory access, with only canonical sandbox-aware runtime paths allowed to add one exact workspace?
rationale: The code change is a deliberate fail-closed security boundary that can affect existing sandbox media delivery, and source inspection alone cannot establish that every non-message caller is intentionally sandbox-blind.

options.title: Require caller-complete proof
options.body: Confirm the fail-closed contract and require real output from `runMessageAction` plus a representative non-message caller before merge.

options.title: Accept helper proof
options.body: Accept the zero-mock helper transcript as sufficient and own the remaining risk that an untested caller loses legitimate sandbox media.

options.title: Centralize sandbox context first
options.body: Pause this patch and refactor media authorization so every legitimate caller receives an owner-issued exact sandbox capability rather than an optional path parameter.

recommendation.title: Require caller-complete proof
recommendation.body: Confirm the fail-closed contract and require real output from `runMessageAction` plus a representative non-message caller before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans the message-action routing and outbound runtime boundaries that must define this security contract.
